meaning:
1) to hiss, whistle, pipe
1a) (Qal) to hiss (as a signal)

elsewhere.note: Though this house is so high, yet everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss; and they will say, ‘Why has Yahweh done this to this land, and to this…
Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.
He will lift up a banner to the nations from far away, and he will whistle for them from the end of the earth. Behold, they will come speedily and swiftly.
I will make this city an astonishment and a hissing. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss because of all its plagues.
All that pass by clap their hands at you. They hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, “Is this the city that men called ‘The perfection…
The merchants among the peoples hiss at you. You have become a terror, and you will be no more.” ’ ”
This is the joyous city that lived carelessly, that said in her heart, “I am, and there is no one besides me.” How she has become a desolation, a place for…
I will signal for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them; and they will increase as they have increased.
